headline: Second Cisco firewall VPN zero-day since August under attack; China-linked actors used ESX flaw as zero-day; PHP2Shell KEV deadline today

bullets.text: New: attackers are exploiting a second Cisco firewall VPN zero-day since August, tracked as CVE-2026-76418.
China-linked actors used ESX logging flaw CVE-2026-41709, rated low severity, as a zero-day to reduce audit trail visibility. CISA added it to KEV on 2026-10-28 with a federal due date of 2026-11-11.

PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) rooted 25 servers and breached a U.S. government-affiliated network; China-linked actors are rooting firewalls with it. CISA's due date is today, 2026-10-29; fixes are in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35.
KEV deadlines: Linux kernel CVE-2026-46300 (missing variable initialization) is due 2026-10-31; Adobe Commerce/Magento CVE-2026-48356 and Google Brotli CVE-2026-111497 are due 2026-11-10.

Breach wave continues: an HHS filing puts the iRhythm toll at 8.2 million; data on more than 41,000 DHS employees, including CBP and ICE agents, is on a leak site; in Japan, So-net exposed about 2.5 million records, GMO told customers to disconnect PCs, and Japan Airlines warned of a breach.

Still active: Volt Typhoon's 'Silent Train' network hid four zero-day campaigns; attackers are hitting Oracle E-Business Suite RCE CVE-2026-101767 days after the patch; CISA warns Node2Shell is being exploited.

actions: Apply Cisco's fix or mitigation for firewall VPN CVE-2026-76418 now and review VPN logs for signs of compromise.
Finish PHP updates to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35 today, including firewalls and appliances, and check exposed hosts for compromise.
Patch VMware ESX for CVE-2026-41709 per Broadcom's advisory; don't deprioritize it for its low score, and review ESX hosts for audit logging gaps.
Apply your distribution's kernel fix for CVE-2026-46300 before 2026-10-31, starting with multi-user and internet-facing Linux hosts.
Patch Adobe Commerce/Magento CVE-2026-48356 and Google Brotli CVE-2026-111497 per vendor advisories before 2026-11-10.
Apply Oracle's patch for E-Business Suite CVE-2026-101767 and check for Node2Shell exposure.
